65	/-! ## The pinned window pushforward -/
66	
67	section WindowBaseChange
68	
69	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
70	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
71	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
72	variable {H : Type u} [AddCommGroup H] [Module k H]
73	
74	/-- **The window pushforward along `R → R'`** (the G-2 orientation seam, recorded once):
75	the `cancelBaseChange`-image of the scalar extension of the window submodule.  This is
76	definitionally the right-hand side of `ker_baseChangeMkQ_eq_map_baseChange`
77	(`Picard/DivCarveKit.lean`), i.e. the submodule of mathlib's
78	`Module.Grassmannian.map`. -/
79	noncomputable def windowBaseChange (N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H)) :
80	    Submodule R' (TensorProduct k R' H) :=
81	  Submodule.map
82	    (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R R' R' H).toLinearMap
83	    (N.baseChange R')
84	
85	variable {R'}
86	
87	/-- The elementwise generator of the window pushforward: the compared ambient vector
88	`cancelBaseChange (1 ⊗ₜ x)` of a window vector `x` lies in the pushed window. -/
89	lemma cancelBaseChange_one_tmul_mem_windowBaseChange {N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H)}
90	    {x : TensorProduct k R H} (hx : x ∈ N) :
91	    TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R R' R' H (1 ⊗ₜ x)
92	      ∈ windowBaseChange R' N :=
93	  Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (Submodule.tmul_mem_baseChange_of_mem 1 hx)
94	
95	/-- The le-criterion for the window pushforward: it suffices to test the compared
96	generators. -/
97	lemma windowBaseChange_le_iff {N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H)}
98	    {P : Submodule R' (TensorProduct k R' H)} :
99	    windowBaseChange R' N ≤ P ↔ ∀ x ∈ N,
100	      TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R R' R' H (1 ⊗ₜ x) ∈ P := by
101	  constructor
102	  · exact fun h x hx => h (cancelBaseChange_one_tmul_mem_windowBaseChange hx)
103	  · intro h
104	    rw [windowBaseChange, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, Submodule.baseChange_eq_span,
105	      Submodule.span_le]
106	    rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
107	    have h1 : (TensorProduct.mk R R' (TensorProduct k R H) 1) m = (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] m := rfl
108	    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, h1]
109	    exact h m hm
110	
111	variable (R')
112	
113	/-- **The window pushforward is the kernel of the base-changed quotient map** — the
114	`Module.Grassmannian.map` spelling, `ker_baseChangeMkQ_eq_map_baseChange` reversed.  The
115	projective-quotient hypothesis is the engine-fed certificate clause. -/
116	lemma windowBaseChange_eq_ker_baseChangeMkQ (N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H))
117	    [Module.Projective R (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N)] :
118	    windowBaseChange R' N
119	      = LinearMap.ker (Module.Grassmannian.baseChangeMkQ R' N) :=
120	  (Grassmannian.ker_baseChangeMkQ_eq_map_baseChange R' N).symm
121	
122	/-- **The pushed-forward window as a Grassmannian point**: given the finite projective
123	rank-`n` certificate for the quotient over `R`, the pushed window is a point of the
124	affine Grassmannian functor over `R'` (quotient clauses through
125	`Module.Grassmannian.baseChangeMkQEquiv` — the same fields as mathlib's
126	`Module.Grassmannian.map`, but on the ambient instance tower `[Algebra R R']`
127	`[IsScalarTower k R R']` rather than a `toAlgebra` transport). -/
128	noncomputable def windowBaseChangeGr (N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H)) (n : ℕ)
129	    [Module.Finite R (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N)]
130	    [Module.Projective R (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N)]
131	    (hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
132	      Module.rankAtStalk (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N) p = n) :
133	    Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k H n R' :=
134	  haveI e : (TensorProduct k R' H ⧸ windowBaseChange R' N) ≃ₗ[R']
135	      R' ⊗[R] (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N) :=
136	    (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (windowBaseChange_eq_ker_baseChangeMkQ R' N)).trans
137	      (Module.Grassmannian.baseChangeMkQEquiv N)
138	  { toSubmodule := windowBaseChange R' N
139	    finite_quotient := Module.Finite.equiv e.symm
140	    projective_quotient := Module.Projective.of_equiv e.symm
141	    rankAtStalk_eq := fun p => by
142	      rw [congrFun (Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv e) p,
143	        Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
144	      exact hrank _ }
145	
146	@[simp]
147	lemma windowBaseChangeGr_coe (N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H)) (n : ℕ)
148	    [Module.Finite R (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N)]
149	    [Module.Projective R (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N)]
150	    (hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
151	      Module.rankAtStalk (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N) p = n) :
152	    (windowBaseChangeGr R' N n hrank).toSubmodule = windowBaseChange R' N :=
153	  rfl
154	
155	end WindowBaseChange

159	section GermTransport
160	
161	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
162	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
163	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']

165	/-- (Implementation) The germ of an `appLE`-compared section is the stalk image of the
166	germ. -/
167	private lemma germ_appLE_apply {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {U : Y.Opens}
168	    {W : X.Opens} (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (s : Γ(Y, U)) (z : X) (hz : z ∈ W) :
169	    (X.presheaf.germ W z hz).hom ((f.appLE U W e).hom s)
170	      = (f.stalkMap z).hom ((Y.presheaf.germ U (f.base z) (e hz)).hom s) := by
171	  have h1 : (f.appLE U W e).hom s
172	      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op).hom ((f.app U).hom s) := rfl
173	  rw [h1, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
174	  exact (f.germ_stalkMap_apply U z (e hz) s).symm
175	
176	/-- **The stalk ideal of the pulled system absorbs stalk images** (the `⊇`-half
177	transport): the `stalkMap`-image of the stalk ideal of `d` at the base point lies in
178	the stalk ideal of the pulled system. -/
179	lemma stalkMap_mem_stalkIdeal_pullback {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
180	    (hreg : ∀ (y z : relCurve C R')
181	      (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y),
182	      ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y)
183	        z hz).hom (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R R') d y)
184	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z))
185	    (z : relCurve C R')
186	    {α : (relCurve C R).presheaf.stalk ((relCurveMap C R R').base z)}
187	    (hα : α ∈ d.stalkIdeal ((relCurveMap C R R').base z)) :
188	    ((relCurveMap C R R').stalkMap z).hom α
189	      ∈ (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') hreg).stalkIdeal z := by
190	  -- the germ of the pulled tautological equation is the stalk image of the germ
191	  have hzmem : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens z :=
192	    (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).mem_opens z
193	  have hgen : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ
194	      ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens z) z hzmem).hom
195	      ((d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') hreg).eqn z)
196	      = ((relCurveMap C R R').stalkMap z).hom
197	          (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base z))
198	            ((relCurveMap C R R').base z)
199	            (d.cover.mem_opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base z))).hom
200	            (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base z))) := by
201	    exact germ_appLE_apply (relCurveMap C R R') le_rfl
202	      (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base z)) z hzmem
203	  -- decompose `α` over the generator of the stalk ideal
204	  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hα
205	  rw [hc, map_mul]
206	  refine Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ?_
207	  rw [Scheme.LocalEquations.stalkIdeal, ← hgen]
208	  exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
209	
210	/-- (Implementation) Membership in a base-changed chart transports along the
211	relative-curve comparison. -/
212	private lemma relCurveMap_base_mem_preimage {V : C.left.Opens} {z : relCurve C R'}
213	    (hz : z ∈ (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
214	    (relCurveMap C R R').base z ∈ (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
215	  have h : z ∈ relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) := by
216	    rw [relCurveMap_preimage]
217	    exact hz
218	  exact h

151	variable {C R π a}
152	variable {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations} (A : DivisorAdaptation C R π d)
153	variable (hH1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1)
154	
155	/-- **The window carve arrow** `R ⊗[k] H_a → W(d)^{Θᵃ}`: the Θ-twisted colength
156	evaluation through the window identification.  Its kernel is `K_a(d)`
157	(`ker_windowCarve`); its surjectivity is the open right-exactness heart of Task 4. -/
158	noncomputable def windowCarve :
159	    R ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤) →ₗ[R]
160	      A.ThetaGlued a :=
161	  A.thetaGluedEval a ∘ₗ (relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1).toLinearMap
162	
163	/-- **Left exactness of the section sequence** (Task 4): the kernel of the window carve
164	arrow is exactly the window submodule `K_a(d)` — the sequence
165	`0 → K_a(d) → R ⊗[k] H_a → W(d)^{Θᵃ}` is exact. -/
166	theorem ker_windowCarve :
167	    LinearMap.ker (windowCarve A hH1) = divisorWindow d hH1 := by
168	  rw [windowCarve, LinearMap.ker_comp, A.ker_thetaGluedEval, divisorWindow]
169	
170	/-- Surjectivity of the carve arrow follows from surjectivity of the evaluation. -/
171	lemma windowCarve_surjective (hsurj : Function.Surjective (A.thetaGluedEval a)) :
172	    Function.Surjective (windowCarve A hH1) := by
173	  rw [windowCarve, LinearMap.coe_comp]
174	  exact hsurj.comp (relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1).surjective
175	
176	/-- **The corank identification** (Task 4, conditional on the right-exactness heart):
177	once the evaluation is surjective, the quotient of the free window by `K_a(d)` is the
178	Θ-twisted colength module `W(d)^{Θᵃ}`. -/
179	noncomputable def windowQuotEquiv (hsurj : Function.Surjective (A.thetaGluedEval a)) :
180	    ((R ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) ⧸
181	        divisorWindow d hH1) ≃ₗ[R] A.ThetaGlued a :=
182	  (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (ker_windowCarve A hH1).symm).trans
183	    ((windowCarve A hH1).quotKerEquivOfSurjective (windowCarve_surjective A hH1 hsurj))

185	variable (n : ℕ)
186	
187	/-- **The conditional Grassmannian point** (worksheet §2.3 step 3, corank certificate):
188	given the right-exactness heart (surjectivity of the evaluation) and a
189	finite-projective rank-`n` certificate for the Θ-twisted colength module `W(d)^{Θᵃ}`,
190	the window submodule `K_a(d)` is a point of the affine Grassmannian functor
191	`grFunctorAff k H_a n R`.  The rank-`n` input at the DD-0 windows is the certificate
192	clause (c2) transported across the twist — the remaining Task-4 obligation together
193	with surjectivity. -/
194	noncomputable def divisorWindowGr (hsurj : Function.Surjective (A.thetaGluedEval a))
195	    (hfin : Module.Finite R (A.ThetaGlued a))
196	    (hproj : Module.Projective R (A.ThetaGlued a))
197	    (hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk (A.ThetaGlued a) p = n) :
198	    Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k
199	      (↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) n R where
200	  toSubmodule := divisorWindow d hH1
201	  finite_quotient :=
202	    letI := hfin
203	    Module.Finite.equiv (windowQuotEquiv A hH1 hsurj).symm
204	  projective_quotient :=
205	    letI := hproj
206	    Module.Projective.of_equiv (windowQuotEquiv A hH1 hsurj).symm
207	  rankAtStalk_eq := fun p => by
208	    rw [congrFun (Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv (windowQuotEquiv A hH1 hsurj)) p]
209	    exact hrank p
210	
211	@[simp]
212	lemma divisorWindowGr_coe (hsurj : Function.Surjective (A.thetaGluedEval a))
213	    (hfin : Module.Finite R (A.ThetaGlued a))
214	    (hproj : Module.Projective R (A.ThetaGlued a))
215	    (hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk (A.ThetaGlued a) p = n) :
216	    ((divisorWindowGr A hH1 n hsurj hfin hproj hrank :
217	        Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k

219	      Submodule R (R ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)))
220	      = divisorWindow d hH1 :=
221	  rfl

10	/-!
11	# Locally certified divisor families: the `DivFamZar` carrier (DD-2 stage S5b)
12	
13	The Addendum-2 repair of the divisor-functor carrier (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`,
14	Addendum 2): the globally-certified `DivFam` is not a Zariski sheaf — the diagonal
15	divisor over `Γ(C \ pt)` is certifiable on a basic-open cover of the base but carries
16	no global certificate — so the faithful functor value is the **locally certified**
17	quotient `DivFamZar`. The generic germ-regularity engines live in
18	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarKit`.
19	
20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyCertified` — the Addendum-2 frozen pin: a span-⊤ family
21	  `g : Fin m → R` with certified divisor families over `Localization.Away (g i)`
22	  divisor-equal to the pulled system; `hreg` is discharged by the Kit's open-immersion
23	  lemma, with the S4 instance provided by `haveI`.
24	* `IsLocallyCertified.of_divEq` — the pin respects divisor equality.
25	* `CertifiedDivisorFamily.isLocallyCertified` — a global certificate is a local one
26	  (trivial cover `g = ![1]`; the certified part is `mapAlg` to `Localization.Away 1`,
27	  whose equations ARE the pulled system on the nose).
28	* `IsLocallyCertified.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors` — **the mapAlg-hreg
29	  engine**: a locally certified system has regular pulled equations along the
30	  comparison of an ARBITRARY test tower `R → R'` — regularity is germ-local, each germ
31	  sits over a chart `Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))` of `R'`, where the
32	  local certificate's regularity transports through its `DivEq` and the landed
33	  certificate-based pullback regularity.
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar` — the quotient of locally certified systems by
35	  `DivEq`, with `mk`, `mk_eq_mk_iff`, `picClass`, and `DivFam.toZar`.
36	
37	Total `DivFamZar.mapAlg` and the Zariski keystones are
38	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg` / `…ZarGlue`.
39	-/

120	equations along the comparison of an ARBITRARY test tower `R → R'`. Regularity is

122	`relCurve C R'` by open immersions; over each, the composite comparison factors
123	through the certified chart `Localization.Away (g i)`, where the certificate's
124	pullback regularity (`DivisorAdaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`)
125	transports through the recorded `DivEq`. -/
126	theorem IsLocallyCertified.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
127	    (hloc : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d)
128	    (y z : relCurve C R') (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) :
129	    ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y)
130	        z hz).hom (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R R') d y)
131	      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z) := by
132	  classical
133	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hloc
134	  -- the away charts of `R'` at the pushed cover, and their immersions
135	  haveI himm : ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin m),
136	      IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R'
137	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) := fun i =>
138	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R'
139	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
140	  -- the pushed family spans the unit ideal of `R'`
141	  have hspan' : Ideal.span (Set.range
142	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) = ⊤ := by
143	    have hrange : Set.range (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
144	        = algebraMap R R' '' Set.range g := by
145	      ext x
146	      constructor
147	      · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
148	        exact ⟨g i.down, ⟨i.down, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
149	      · rintro ⟨-, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
150	        exact ⟨⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
151	    rw [hrange, ← Ideal.map_span, hg, Ideal.map_top]
152	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_immersion_cover
153	    (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => relCurveMap C R'
154	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))))
155	    (fun y' => exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R'
156	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
157	      (fun i => Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) hspan' y')
158	    (relCurveMap C R R') d (fun i ζ => ?_) y z hz
159	  -- over the chart at `g i`: factor the composite through the certified localization
160	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i.down
161	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))) :=
162	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i.down)) (g i.down)
163	  -- the away map `Localization.Away (g i) → Localization.Away (φ (g i))` as an
164	  -- algebra tower
165	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away (g i.down))
166	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
167	    (IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers (g i.down))
168	      (T := Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
169	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R')
170	      (by
171	        rintro x ⟨e, rfl⟩
172	        use e
173	        simp)).toAlgebra
174	  haveI : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
175	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
176	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
177	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.map_comp,
178	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq])
179	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (g i.down))
180	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
181	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
182	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R (Localization.Away (g i.down)),
183	        ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
184	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
185	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))),
186	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R
187	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))])
188	  -- the comparison triangle through the two factorizations of `C_{T i} → C_R`
189	  have hcomp₁ : relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
190	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
191	      ≫ relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
192	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
193	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := Localization.Away (g i.down))
194	      (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
195	  have hcomp₂ : relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
196	      ≫ relCurveMap C R R'
197	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
198	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := R')
199	      (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
200	  have step1 := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_congr hcomp₂ d ζ
201	  have step2 := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_comp hcomp₁ d
202	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
203	      (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))) d) ζ
204	  have hfinal := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_self_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_divEq
205	    (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
206	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) hGdiv ζ
207	    (G.adaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
208	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
209	      G.certified.projective_colength ζ ζ
210	      ((G.eqns.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
211	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))))).mem_opens ζ))
212	  exact ((step1.trans step2).symm ▸ hfinal)

/-- **The two halves assembled at one window** (adaptation form): for a certified
adaptation over `R` and a ledger window `a ≥ M`, the window of the pulled-back system
IS the pushed-forward window.  `⊇` is `windowBaseChange_divisorWindow_le`; `⊆` is the
DDR-5 rank engine on the two finite projective rank-`g` quotients, with all certificate
slots discharged by the G-1 keystones over `R` and the transported certificate over
`R'`.  No Noetherian hypotheses. -/
theorem divisorWindow_pulledEquations_eq {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    {A : DivisorAdaptation C R π d} {g : ℕ} (hc : A.IsCertified g)
    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    (ha1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1)
    (hMa : windowM_choice π hπ g ≤ a) :
    divisorWindow (A.pulledEquations R' hc.projective_colength) ha1
      = windowBaseChange R' (divisorWindow d ha1) := by
  -- the `R`-level window quotient is finite projective of rank `g`
  have hsurjR : Function.Surjective (A.thetaGluedEval a) :=
    hc.thetaGluedEval_surjective (C := C) (π := π) hπ hO hχ ha1 hMa
  haveI hfinR : Module.Finite R
      ((TensorProduct k R
          ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) ⧸
        divisorWindow d ha1) :=
    haveI := hc.finite_thetaGlued a
    Module.Finite.equiv (windowQuotEquiv A ha1 hsurjR).symm
  haveI hprojR : Module.Projective R
      ((TensorProduct k R
          ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) ⧸
        divisorWindow d ha1) :=
    haveI := hc.projective_thetaGlued a
    Module.Projective.of_equiv (windowQuotEquiv A ha1 hsurjR).symm
  have hrankR : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
      Module.rankAtStalk
        ((TensorProduct k R
            ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) ⧸
          divisorWindow d ha1) p = g := fun p => by
    rw [congrFun (Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv (windowQuotEquiv A ha1 hsurjR)) p]
    exact hc.rankAtStalk_thetaGlued a p

    hc'.thetaGluedEval_surjective (C := C) (π := π) hπ hO hχ ha1 hMa

    (windowBaseChange_divisorWindow_le C R' π a

202	    (hle : x.toSubmodule ≤ divisorWindow d hH1) :
203	    divisorWindow d hH1 = x.toSubmodule :=
204	  divisorWindow_eq_of_le A hH1 x hsurj (hc.finite_thetaGlued a)
205	    (hc.projective_thetaGlued a) (fun p => hc.rankAtStalk_thetaGlued a p) hle
206	
207	end WindowEq
208	
209	/-! ## The seed form: the ε-projection identity at the seed's window -/
210	
211	section SeedEq
212	
213	variable {a g : ℕ} [IsNoetherianRing R]
214	
215	/-- **The ε-projection identity at the seed's window** (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` §3
216	item 5): for a theta generator seed drawn from the Grassmannian point `x` — its
217	submodule `K` is the image of `x` under the window identification, the W1 spelling —
218	the window submodule of the constructed family is exactly `x`.  Containment is DDR-3's
219	`le_vanishingSubmodule` (the landed half); equality is the rank engine on the
220	certificate slots. -/
221	theorem ThetaGeneratorSeed.divisorWindow_eq
222	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1)
223	    (x : Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k
224	      (↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) g R)
225	    (D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R π a
226	      (Submodule.map (relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1).toLinearMap x.toSubmodule))
227	    (hD : D.IsGenerator) (hc : (D.divisorAdaptation hD).IsCertified g)
228	    (hsurj : Function.Surjective ((D.divisorAdaptation hD).thetaGluedEval a)) :
229	    divisorWindow (D.localEquations hD) hH1 = x.toSubmodule :=
230	  divisorWindow_eq_of_le_of_isCertified (D.divisorAdaptation hD) hc hH1 x hsurj
231	    (Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp (D.le_vanishingSubmodule hD))
232	
233	variable (g) in
234	/-- **The certified divisor family of a theta generator seed**: the DDR-3
235	local-equation system with its adaptation, bundled with a degree-`g` certificate (the
236	DDR-4 output) into the DD-1 carrier. -/
237	noncomputable def ThetaGeneratorSeed.certifiedFamily
238	    {K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)} (D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R π a K)
239	    (hD : D.IsGenerator) (hc : (D.divisorAdaptation hD).IsCertified g) :
240	    CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π g where
241	  eqns := D.localEquations hD
242	  adaptation := D.divisorAdaptation hD
243	  certified := hc
244	
245	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
246	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
247	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsDominant π] in
248	@[simp]
249	lemma ThetaGeneratorSeed.certifiedFamily_eqns
250	    {K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)} (D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R π a K)
251	    (hD : D.IsGenerator) (hc : (D.divisorAdaptation hD).IsCertified g) :
252	    (D.certifiedFamily g hD hc).eqns = D.localEquations hD :=
253	  rfl
254	
255	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
256	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
257	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsDominant π] in
258	@[simp]
259	lemma ThetaGeneratorSeed.certifiedFamily_adaptation
260	    {K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)} (D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R π a K)
261	    (hD : D.IsGenerator) (hc : (D.divisorAdaptation hD).IsCertified g) :
262	    (D.certifiedFamily g hD hc).adaptation = D.divisorAdaptation hD :=
263	  rfl
264	
265	end SeedEq
266	
267	/-! ## The pair form: `ε` returns the tautological pair -/
268	
269	section Eps
270	
271	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
272	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
273	variable (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
274	variable {g : ℕ}
275	
276	/-- **The ε-pair identity for a certified family** (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` §3
277	item 5): if the two window submodules of a certified family contain the Grassmannian
278	pair `(x₁, x₂)` at the pinned ledger exponents `M`, `M + s`, then `ε` of the family
279	*is* the pair.  The certificate slots fire from the family's own certificate
280	(I-0211); only the two evaluation surjectivities are threaded (the DD-4 Task-4
281	boundary, discharged by `thetaGluedEval_surjective` under `hfib`). -/
282	theorem divFamEps_mk_eq_of_le (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π g)
283	    (x₁ : Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k
284	      (↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) g R)
285	    (x₂ : Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k
286	      (↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
287	        ((windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g) • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) g R)
288	    (hsurj₁ : Function.Surjective
289	      (G.adaptation.thetaGluedEval (windowM_choice π hπ g)))
290	    (hsurj₂ : Function.Surjective
291	      (G.adaptation.thetaGluedEval (windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g)))
292	    (hle₁ : x₁.toSubmodule ≤ divisorWindow G.eqns (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g))
293	    (hle₂ : x₂.toSubmodule ≤ divisorWindow G.eqns (relThetaPairH1_windowMS C π hπ g)) :
294	    divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk G) = (x₁.toSubmodule, x₂.toSubmodule) := by
295	  rw [divFamEps_mk]
296	  exact Prod.ext
297	    (divisorWindow_eq_of_le_of_isCertified G.adaptation G.certified
298	      (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g) x₁ hsurj₁ hle₁)
299	    (divisorWindow_eq_of_le_of_isCertified G.adaptation G.certified
300	      (relThetaPairH1_windowMS C π hπ g) x₂ hsurj₂ hle₂)
301	
302	variable [IsNoetherianRing R]
303	
304	/-- **THE ε-PROJECTION IDENTITY** (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` §3 item 5): `ε` of the
305	family constructed from a theta generator seed drawn from the Grassmannian point `x₁`
306	at the embedding window `M` is the tautological pair `(x₁, x₂)`.  The first-window
307	containment is DDR-3's `le_vanishingSubmodule`; the second-window containment `hle₂`
308	is the named DDR-5 boundary (fibrewise second-window exactness upgraded to relative
309	divisibility — the W2/DDR-4 fan-in; a fibrewise statement does NOT suffice over
310	nonreduced chart rings, spec risk 5).  The universal carve-pair instantiation is the
311	in-progress G-4 chain rooted at `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeSeedUniv`. -/
312	theorem ThetaGeneratorSeed.divFamEps_certifiedFamily
313	    (x₁ : Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k
314	      (↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) g R)
315	    (x₂ : Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k
316	      (↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
317	        ((windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g) • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) g R)
318	    (D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
319	      (Submodule.map
320	        (relThetaWindowEquiv C R π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
321	          (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)).toLinearMap x₁.toSubmodule))
322	    (hD : D.IsGenerator) (hc : (D.divisorAdaptation hD).IsCertified g)
323	    (hsurj₁ : Function.Surjective
324	      ((D.divisorAdaptation hD).thetaGluedEval (windowM_choice π hπ g)))
325	    (hsurj₂ : Function.Surjective
326	      ((D.divisorAdaptation hD).thetaGluedEval
327	        (windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g)))
328	    (hle₂ : x₂.toSubmodule ≤
329	      divisorWindow (D.localEquations hD) (relThetaPairH1_windowMS C π hπ g)) :
330	    divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk (D.certifiedFamily g hD hc))
331	      = (x₁.toSubmodule, x₂.toSubmodule) :=
332	  divFamEps_mk_eq_of_le hπ (D.certifiedFamily g hD hc) x₁ x₂ hsurj₁ hsurj₂
333	    (Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp (D.le_vanishingSubmodule hD)) hle₂
334	
335	end Eps
336	
337	end AlgebraicGeometry

381	
382	/-- The product of the chart-local colength modules (an `abbrev`, so the `Pi.module`
383	instances apply directly — probe finding, spec §1b(iii)). -/
384	noncomputable abbrev chartProd : Type u := ∀ j : A.index, A.colength j
385	
386	/-- The product of the overlap colength modules over ordered index pairs. -/
387	noncomputable abbrev ovlProd : Type u := ∀ p : A.index × A.index, A.ovlColength p.1 p.2
388	
389	/-- The left arrow of the equalizer: restrict the `p.1` component to each overlap. -/
390	noncomputable def deltaLeft : A.chartProd →ₗ[R] A.ovlProd :=
391	  LinearMap.pi
392	    (fun p : A.index × A.index => (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj p.1)
393	
394	/-- The right arrow of the equalizer: restrict the `p.2` component to each overlap. -/
395	noncomputable def deltaRight : A.chartProd →ₗ[R] A.ovlProd :=
396	  LinearMap.pi
397	    (fun p : A.index × A.index => (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj p.2)
398	
399	/-- **The glued colength module `W(d)`** (worksheet §1.1 (c2)): the equalizer of the two
400	overlap-restriction arrows on the product of chart-local colengths, spelled as the
401	kernel of their difference (so the `FlatCokernel` base-change keystone applies
402	verbatim); the equalizer description is `mem_gluedSubmodule_iff`. -/
403	noncomputable def gluedSubmodule : Submodule R A.chartProd :=
404	  LinearMap.ker (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)
405	
406	/-- The equalizer description of the glued colength module: componentwise agreement of
407	the two overlap restrictions. -/
408	lemma mem_gluedSubmodule_iff (s : A.chartProd) :
409	    s ∈ A.gluedSubmodule ↔ ∀ p : A.index × A.index,
410	      A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1) = A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2) := by
411	  simp only [gluedSubmodule, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero,
412	    funext_iff, deltaLeft, deltaRight, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp,
413	    Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
414	
415	/-- The glued colength module, as a type. -/
416	noncomputable abbrev Glued : Type u := ↥A.gluedSubmodule
417	
418	/-! ### The certificate -/
419	
420	/-- **The colength certificate** (worksheet §1.1 (c1)/(c2) in the spec-dd-1 §1c frozen
421	spelling): chart-local colengths finite projective over `R` (c1); the glued module
422	finite projective of constant fibre rank `n` — honest finrank at every prime through
423	`Module.rankAtStalk` (c2); and the two flat-cokernel clauses (c3)/(c4) that make
424	certificates base-change along ARBITRARY test maps (trivial over a field; transported
425	by right-exactness; consumed by `FlatCokernel.tensorKer_bijective_of_flat_coker`). -/
426	structure IsCertified (n : ℕ) : Prop where
427	  /-- (c1) Each chart-local colength module is a finite `R`-module. -/
428	  finite_colength : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (A.colength j)
429	  /-- (c1) Each chart-local colength module is projective over `R`. -/
430	  projective_colength : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)
431	  /-- (c2) The glued colength module is a finite `R`-module. -/
432	  finite_glued : Module.Finite R A.Glued
433	  /-- (c2) The glued colength module is projective over `R`. -/
434	  projective_glued : Module.Projective R A.Glued
435	  /-- (c2) The glued colength module has constant fibre rank `n`. -/
436	  rankAtStalk_glued : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk A.Glued p = n
437	  /-- (c3) The cokernel of `W(d) ↪ Π_j colength j` is flat. -/
438	  flat_coker_incl : Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule)
439	  /-- (c4) The cokernel of the difference arrow is flat. -/
440	  flat_coker_diff :
441	    Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
442	
443	end DivisorAdaptation
444	
445	/-! ## The certified family and the divisor-functor value -/
446	
447	variable (n : ℕ)
448	
449	/-- **A certified divisor family of degree `n` over the test ring `R`** (the worksheet's
450	(D1) pair `(d, c)`): a local-equation system with a certified finite chart
451	adaptation. -/
452	structure CertifiedDivisorFamily [IsAffineHom π] : Type u where
453	  /-- The local-equation system on the relative curve. -/
454	  eqns : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations
455	  /-- The finite chart adaptation refining it. -/
456	  adaptation : DivisorAdaptation C R π eqns
457	  /-- The colength certificate of degree `n`. -/
458	  certified : adaptation.IsCertified n
459	
460	/-- The divisor-equality setoid on certified families: the underlying local-equation
461	systems cut the same divisor (`Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq`); the adaptation and
462	certificate are per-representative data and do not enter the relation. -/
463	def divFamSetoid [IsAffineHom π] : Setoid (CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) where
464	  r F G := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq F.eqns G.eqns
465	  iseqv :=
466	    ⟨fun F => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl F.eqns,
467	     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩
468	
469	/-- **The divisor-functor value on the affine test `R`** (worksheet §1.1): certified
470	divisor families of degree `n` up to divisor equality. A `Type u` quotient — the
471	carrier the affine-opens-limit vehicle ranges over. -/
472	def DivFam [IsAffineHom π] : Type u := Quotient (divFamSetoid C R π n)
473	
474	namespace DivFam
475	
476	variable {C R π n} [IsAffineHom π]
477	
478	/-- The class of a certified family. -/
479	def mk (F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) : DivFam C R π n :=
480	  Quotient.mk (divFamSetoid C R π n) F
481	
482	lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {F G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n} :
483	    mk F = mk G ↔ Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq F.eqns G.eqns :=
484	  Quotient.eq (r := divFamSetoid C R π n)
485	
486	/-- **The Picard class of a divisor family** `𝒪(D)`: well defined on the quotient by
487	the class laws (`picClass_eq_of_divEq`). This is the Abel hook DAT-C consumes. -/
488	noncomputable def picClass (F : DivFam C R π n) : (relCurve C R).CechPic :=
489	  Quotient.lift (fun F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n => F.eqns.picClass)
490	    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_eq_of_divEq h) F
491	
492	@[simp]
493	lemma picClass_mk (F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) :
494	    picClass (mk F) = F.eqns.picClass :=
495	  rfl
496	
497	end DivFam
498	
499	end AlgebraicGeometry

153	theorem Module.eq_of_isLocalized_span (x y : M) (h : ∀ r : s, f r x = f r y) : x = y := by
154	  suffices Module.eqIdeal R x y = ⊤ by simpa [Module.eqIdeal] using (eq_top_iff_one _).mp this
155	  by_contra ne
156	  have ⟨r, hrs, disj⟩ := exists_disjoint_powers_of_span_eq_top s span_eq _ ne
157	  let r : s := ⟨r, hrs⟩
158	  have ⟨⟨_, n, rfl⟩, eq⟩ := (IsLocalizedModule.eq_iff_exists (.powers r.1) _).mp (h r)
159	  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp disj eq ⟨n, rfl⟩

161	theorem Module.eq_zero_of_isLocalized_span (x : M) (h : ∀ r : s, f r x = 0) : x = 0 :=
162	  eq_of_isLocalized_span s span_eq _ f x 0 <| by simpa only [map_zero] using h

164	theorem Submodule.mem_of_isLocalized_span {m : M} {N : Submodule R M}
165	    (h : ∀ r : s, f r m ∈ N.localized₀ (.powers r.1) (f r)) : m ∈ N := by
166	  let I : Ideal R := N.comap (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R M m)
167	  suffices I = ⊤ by simpa [I] using I.eq_top_iff_one.mp this
168	  by_contra! ne
169	  have ⟨r, hrs, disj⟩ := exists_disjoint_powers_of_span_eq_top s span_eq _ ne
170	  let r : s := ⟨r, hrs⟩
171	  obtain ⟨a, ha, t, e⟩ := h r
172	  rw [← IsLocalizedModule.mk'_one (.powers r.1), IsLocalizedModule.mk'_eq_mk'_iff] at e
173	  have ⟨u, hu⟩ := e
174	  simp_rw [smul_smul] at hu
175	  exact Set.disjoint_right.mp disj (u * t).2 (by apply hu ▸ smul_mem _ _ ha)

178	    (h : ∀ r : s, N.localized₀ (.powers r.1) (f r) ≤ P.localized₀ (.powers r.1) (f r)) : N ≤ P :=
179	  fun m hm ↦ mem_of_isLocalized_span s span_eq _ f fun r ↦ h r ⟨m, hm, 1, by simp⟩

183	  le_antisymm (le_of_isLocalized_span s span_eq _ _ fun r ↦ (h r).le)

187	    (h : ∀ r : s, N.localized₀ (.powers r.1) (f r) = ⊥) : N = ⊥ :=
188	  eq_of_isLocalized₀_span s span_eq Mₚ f fun _ ↦ by simp only [h, Submodule.localized₀_bot]
189

191	    (h : ∀ r : s, N.localized₀ (.powers r.1) (f r) = ⊤) : N = ⊤ :=
192	  eq_of_isLocalized₀_span s span_eq Mₚ f fun _ ↦ by simp only [h, Submodule.localized₀_top]
193

195	    (h : ∀ r, N.localized' (Rₚ r) (.powers r.1) (f r) = P.localized' (Rₚ r) (.powers r.1) (f r)) :
196	    N = P :=
197	  eq_of_isLocalized₀_span s span_eq _ f fun r ↦ congr(restrictScalars _ $(h r))
198	
199	theorem Submodule.eq_bot_of_isLocalized'_span {N : Submodule R M}
200	    (h : ∀ r : s, N.localized' (Rₚ r) (.powers r.1) (f r) = ⊥) : N = ⊥ :=

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarKit
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZariskiSep
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZariskiGlueKit
9	
10	/-!
11	# Locally certified divisor families: the `DivFamZar` carrier (DD-2 stage S5b)
12	
13	The Addendum-2 repair of the divisor-functor carrier (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`,
14	Addendum 2): the globally-certified `DivFam` is not a Zariski sheaf — the diagonal
15	divisor over `Γ(C \ pt)` is certifiable on a basic-open cover of the base but carries
16	no global certificate — so the faithful functor value is the **locally certified**
17	quotient `DivFamZar`. The generic germ-regularity engines live in
18	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarKit`.
19	
20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyCertified` — the Addendum-2 frozen pin: a span-⊤ family
21	  `g : Fin m → R` with certified divisor families over `Localization.Away (g i)`
22	  divisor-equal to the pulled system; `hreg` is discharged by the Kit's open-immersion
23	  lemma, with the S4 instance provided by `haveI`.
24	* `IsLocallyCertified.of_divEq` — the pin respects divisor equality.
25	* `CertifiedDivisorFamily.isLocallyCertified` — a global certificate is a local one
26	  (trivial cover `g = ![1]`; the certified part is `mapAlg` to `Localization.Away 1`,
27	  whose equations ARE the pulled system on the nose).
28	* `IsLocallyCertified.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors` — **the mapAlg-hreg
29	  engine**: a locally certified system has regular pulled equations along the
30	  comparison of an ARBITRARY test tower `R → R'` — regularity is germ-local, each germ
31	  sits over a chart `Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))` of `R'`, where the
32	  local certificate's regularity transports through its `DivEq` and the landed
33	  certificate-based pullback regularity.
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar` — the quotient of locally certified systems by
35	  `DivEq`, with `mk`, `mk_eq_mk_iff`, `picClass`, and `DivFam.toZar`.
36	
37	Total `DivFamZar.mapAlg` and the Zariski keystones are
38	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg` / `…ZarGlue`.
39	-/
40	
41	set_option autoImplicit false
42	/- Statements mix `Γ(relCurve C R, ·)` with opens produced on the product spelling
43	`(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`; see `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/
44	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
45	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
46	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
47	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
48	
49	universe u
50	
51	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TopologicalSpace
52	open Opposite
53	
54	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
55	
56	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
57	
58	/-! ## The locally certified pin -/
59	
60	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
61	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
62	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsAffineHom π]
63	
64	/-- **The Addendum-2 frozen pin** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): a
65	local-equation system on the relative curve is *locally certified* in degree `n` if
66	some span-⊤ family `g : Fin m → R` carries certified divisor families over the
67	localizations `Localization.Away (g i)` that are divisor-equal to the pulled system.
68	The pullback's regularity hypothesis is discharged once and for all by the Kit's
69	open-immersion lemma — the comparison of an away localization is an open immersion
70	(the S4 instance, provided by `haveI`). -/
71	def IsLocallyCertified (n : ℕ) (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) : Prop :=
72	  ∃ (m : ℕ) (g : Fin m → R), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤ ∧
73	    ∀ i : Fin m,
74	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
75	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
76	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away (g i)) π n,
77	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
78	          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
79	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
80	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) d))
81	
82	variable {C R π}
83	
84	/-- **The locally certified pin respects divisor equality**: the local `DivEq`s
85	transport through `divEq_pullback` (regularity along the chart immersions is free). -/
86	theorem IsLocallyCertified.of_divEq {n : ℕ} {d d' : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
87	    (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) (h : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d d') :
88	    IsLocallyCertified C R π n d' := by
89	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hd
90	  refine ⟨m, g, hg, fun i => ?_⟩
91	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
92	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
93	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i
94	  exact ⟨G, hGdiv.trans
95	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
96	      h _ _)⟩
97	
98	/-- **A global certificate is a local one** (the trivial cover `g = ![1]`): the
99	certified part over `Localization.Away (1 : R)` is `mapAlg` of the family, whose
100	equations are the pulled system on the nose (`pulledEquations` IS the pullback along
101	the comparison; the regularity proofs are proof-irrelevant). -/
102	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.isLocallyCertified {n : ℕ}
103	    (F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) : IsLocallyCertified C R π n F.eqns := by
104	  refine ⟨1, fun _ => (1 : R), ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
105	  · have hrange : Set.range (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : R)) = {1} := Set.range_const
106	    rw [hrange, Ideal.span_singleton_one]
107	  · haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (1 : R))) :=
108	      isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (1 : R)) 1
109	    exact ⟨F.mapAlg (Localization.Away (1 : R)) n,
110	      Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl _⟩
111	
112	/-! ## The mapAlg-hreg engine -/
113	
114	section MapAlgHreg
115	
116	variable {n : ℕ} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
117	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
118	
119	/-- **The mapAlg-hreg engine** (S5b): a locally certified system has regular pulled
120	equations along the comparison of an ARBITRARY test tower `R → R'`. Regularity is
121	germ-local on the curve: the charts `Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))` cover
122	`relCurve C R'` by open immersions; over each, the composite comparison factors
123	through the certified chart `Localization.Away (g i)`, where the certificate's
124	pullback regularity (`DivisorAdaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`)
125	transports through the recorded `DivEq`. -/
126	theorem IsLocallyCertified.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
127	    (hloc : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d)
128	    (y z : relCurve C R') (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) :
129	    ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y)
130	        z hz).hom (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R R') d y)
131	      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z) := by
132	  classical
133	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hloc
134	  -- the away charts of `R'` at the pushed cover, and their immersions
135	  haveI himm : ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin m),
136	      IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R'
137	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) := fun i =>
138	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R'
139	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
140	  -- the pushed family spans the unit ideal of `R'`
141	  have hspan' : Ideal.span (Set.range
142	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) = ⊤ := by
143	    have hrange : Set.range (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
144	        = algebraMap R R' '' Set.range g := by
145	      ext x
146	      constructor
147	      · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
148	        exact ⟨g i.down, ⟨i.down, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
149	      · rintro ⟨-, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
150	        exact ⟨⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
151	    rw [hrange, ← Ideal.map_span, hg, Ideal.map_top]
152	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_immersion_cover
153	    (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => relCurveMap C R'
154	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))))
155	    (fun y' => exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R'
156	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
157	      (fun i => Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) hspan' y')
158	    (relCurveMap C R R') d (fun i ζ => ?_) y z hz
159	  -- over the chart at `g i`: factor the composite through the certified localization
160	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i.down
161	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))) :=
162	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i.down)) (g i.down)
163	  -- the away map `Localization.Away (g i) → Localization.Away (φ (g i))` as an
164	  -- algebra tower

166	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
167	    (IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers (g i.down))
168	      (T := Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
169	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R')
170	      (by
171	        rintro x ⟨e, rfl⟩
172	        use e
173	        simp)).toAlgebra
174	  haveI : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
175	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
176	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
177	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.map_comp,
178	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq])
179	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (g i.down))
180	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
181	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
182	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R (Localization.Away (g i.down)),
183	        ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
184	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
185	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))),
186	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R
187	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))])

`k`-anchored ambient comparison `R ⊗[k] H_a → R' ⊗[k] H_a` intertwines the window

`divFamEps_mapAlg` (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyEpsNaturality`): it feeds the
`⊇` (formal) half by germ transport, and pins the pushed-forward window submodule for
the `⊆` (certificate) half.

**Orientation seam (recorded once, spec-dd-3 §0 discipline).**  The ambient comparison
is pinned as `AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R R' R' H` applied to
`1 ⊗ₜ (·)` — the SAME orientation as `ker_baseChangeMkQ_eq_map_baseChange`

  cohomology class as the pair of chart restrictions of its global section.
* `relSectionsMap_relSectionsMap` — the tower law of the sections comparison,

* `resHom_relThetaWindowEquiv_cancelBaseChange_fst/snd` — **THE TRIANGLE**: the window
  identification over `R'` of the compared ambient vector is the compared window

61	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

63	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

65	/-! ## The pinned window pushforward -/
66	
67	section WindowBaseChange
68	
69	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
70	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
71	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
72	variable {H : Type u} [AddCommGroup H] [Module k H]
73	
74	/-- **The window pushforward along `R → R'`** (the G-2 orientation seam, recorded once):
75	the `cancelBaseChange`-image of the scalar extension of the window submodule.  This is
76	definitionally the right-hand side of `ker_baseChangeMkQ_eq_map_baseChange`
77	(`Picard/DivCarveKit.lean`), i.e. the submodule of mathlib's
78	`Module.Grassmannian.map`. -/
79	noncomputable def windowBaseChange (N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H)) :
80	    Submodule R' (TensorProduct k R' H) :=
81	  Submodule.map
82	    (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R R' R' H).toLinearMap
83	    (N.baseChange R')
84	
85	variable {R'}
86	
87	/-- The elementwise generator of the window pushforward: the compared ambient vector
88	`cancelBaseChange (1 ⊗ₜ x)` of a window vector `x` lies in the pushed window. -/
89	lemma cancelBaseChange_one_tmul_mem_windowBaseChange {N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H)}
90	    {x : TensorProduct k R H} (hx : x ∈ N) :
91	    TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R R' R' H (1 ⊗ₜ x)
92	      ∈ windowBaseChange R' N :=
93	  Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (Submodule.tmul_mem_baseChange_of_mem 1 hx)
94	
95	/-- The le-criterion for the window pushforward: it suffices to test the compared
96	generators. -/
97	lemma windowBaseChange_le_iff {N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H)}
98	    {P : Submodule R' (TensorProduct k R' H)} :
99	    windowBaseChange R' N ≤ P ↔ ∀ x ∈ N,
100	      TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R R' R' H (1 ⊗ₜ x) ∈ P := by
101	  constructor
102	  · exact fun h x hx => h (cancelBaseChange_one_tmul_mem_windowBaseChange hx)
103	  · intro h
104	    rw [windowBaseChange, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, Submodule.baseChange_eq_span,
105	      Submodule.span_le]
106	    rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
107	    have h1 : (TensorProduct.mk R R' (TensorProduct k R H) 1) m = (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] m := rfl
108	    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, h1]
109	    exact h m hm
110	
111	variable (R')
112	
113	/-- **The window pushforward is the kernel of the base-changed quotient map** — the
114	`Module.Grassmannian.map` spelling, `ker_baseChangeMkQ_eq_map_baseChange` reversed.  The
115	projective-quotient hypothesis is the engine-fed certificate clause. -/
116	lemma windowBaseChange_eq_ker_baseChangeMkQ (N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H))
117	    [Module.Projective R (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N)] :
118	    windowBaseChange R' N
119	      = LinearMap.ker (Module.Grassmannian.baseChangeMkQ R' N) :=
120	  (Grassmannian.ker_baseChangeMkQ_eq_map_baseChange R' N).symm
121	
122	/-- **The pushed-forward window as a Grassmannian point**: given the finite projective
123	rank-`n` certificate for the quotient over `R`, the pushed window is a point of the
124	affine Grassmannian functor over `R'` (quotient clauses through
125	`Module.Grassmannian.baseChangeMkQEquiv` — the same fields as mathlib's
126	`Module.Grassmannian.map`, but on the ambient instance tower `[Algebra R R']`
127	`[IsScalarTower k R R']` rather than a `toAlgebra` transport). -/
128	noncomputable def windowBaseChangeGr (N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H)) (n : ℕ)
129	    [Module.Finite R (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N)]
130	    [Module.Projective R (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N)]
131	    (hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
132	      Module.rankAtStalk (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N) p = n) :
133	    Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k H n R' :=
134	  haveI e : (TensorProduct k R' H ⧸ windowBaseChange R' N) ≃ₗ[R']
135	      R' ⊗[R] (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N) :=
136	    (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (windowBaseChange_eq_ker_baseChangeMkQ R' N)).trans
137	      (Module.Grassmannian.baseChangeMkQEquiv N)
138	  { toSubmodule := windowBaseChange R' N
139	    finite_quotient := Module.Finite.equiv e.symm
140	    projective_quotient := Module.Projective.of_equiv e.symm
141	    rankAtStalk_eq := fun p => by
142	      rw [congrFun (Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv e) p,
143	        Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
144	      exact hrank _ }
145	
146	@[simp]
147	lemma windowBaseChangeGr_coe (N : Submodule R (TensorProduct k R H)) (n : ℕ)
148	    [Module.Finite R (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N)]
149	    [Module.Projective R (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N)]
150	    (hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
151	      Module.rankAtStalk (TensorProduct k R H ⧸ N) p = n) :
152	    (windowBaseChangeGr R' N n hrank).toSubmodule = windowBaseChange R' N :=
153	  rfl
154	
155	end WindowBaseChange

157	/-! ## Germ transport along the relative-curve comparison -/
158	
159	section GermTransport
160	
161	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
162	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
163	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
164	
165	/-- (Implementation) The germ of an `appLE`-compared section is the stalk image of the
166	germ. -/
167	private lemma germ_appLE_apply {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {U : Y.Opens}
168	    {W : X.Opens} (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (s : Γ(Y, U)) (z : X) (hz : z ∈ W) :
169	    (X.presheaf.germ W z hz).hom ((f.appLE U W e).hom s)
170	      = (f.stalkMap z).hom ((Y.presheaf.germ U (f.base z) (e hz)).hom s) := by
171	  have h1 : (f.appLE U W e).hom s
172	      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op).hom ((f.app U).hom s) := rfl
173	  rw [h1, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
174	  exact (f.germ_stalkMap_apply U z (e hz) s).symm
175	
176	/-- **The stalk ideal of the pulled system absorbs stalk images** (the `⊇`-half
177	transport): the `stalkMap`-image of the stalk ideal of `d` at the base point lies in
178	the stalk ideal of the pulled system. -/
179	lemma stalkMap_mem_stalkIdeal_pullback {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
180	    (hreg : ∀ (y z : relCurve C R')
181	      (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y),
182	      ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y)
183	        z hz).hom (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R R') d y)
184	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z))
185	    (z : relCurve C R')
186	    {α : (relCurve C R).presheaf.stalk ((relCurveMap C R R').base z)}
187	    (hα : α ∈ d.stalkIdeal ((relCurveMap C R R').base z)) :
188	    ((relCurveMap C R R').stalkMap z).hom α
189	      ∈ (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') hreg).stalkIdeal z := by
190	  -- the germ of the pulled tautological equation is the stalk image of the germ
191	  have hzmem : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens z :=
192	    (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).mem_opens z
193	  have hgen : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ
194	      ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens z) z hzmem).hom
195	      ((d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') hreg).eqn z)
196	      = ((relCurveMap C R R').stalkMap z).hom
197	          (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base z))
198	            ((relCurveMap C R R').base z)
199	            (d.cover.mem_opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base z))).hom
200	            (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base z))) := by
201	    exact germ_appLE_apply (relCurveMap C R R') le_rfl
202	      (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base z)) z hzmem
203	  -- decompose `α` over the generator of the stalk ideal
204	  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hα
205	  rw [hc, map_mul]
206	  refine Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ?_
207	  rw [Scheme.LocalEquations.stalkIdeal, ← hgen]
208	  exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
209	
210	/-- (Implementation) Membership in a base-changed chart transports along the
211	relative-curve comparison. -/
212	private lemma relCurveMap_base_mem_preimage {V : C.left.Opens} {z : relCurve C R'}
213	    (hz : z ∈ (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
214	    (relCurveMap C R R').base z ∈ (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
215	  have h : z ∈ relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) := by
216	    rw [relCurveMap_preimage]
217	    exact hz
218	  exact h

variable {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] {n : ℕ}

/-- **`toZar` is injective**: both `DivFam` and `DivFamZar` are quotients by divisor
equality of the underlying local-equation systems, and `toZar` is induced by the
identity on representatives. -/
theorem DivFam.toZar_injective :
    Function.Injective (DivFam.toZar (C := C) (R := S) (π := π) (n := n)) := by
  intro F G h
  induction F using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h F =>
    induction G using Quotient.inductionOn with
    | h G => exact DivFam.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr (DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp h)

/-- **Step 1 — the certificate cover** (`informal/w4-ddr9-worksheet.md` §2.1 step 1;
the carrier pattern inside `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat`, made public): a
locally certified divisor class over `S` restricts, on a finite span-⊤ family of
basic opens, to classes of certified divisor families on the canonical
away-localizations. -/
theorem DivFamZar.exists_certified_away_rep (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π n) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (h : Fin m → S), Ideal.span (Set.range h) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ l : Fin m, ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away (h l)) π n,
        (DivFam.mk G).toZar = DivFamZar.mapAlg (Localization.Away (h l)) n F₀ := by
  obtain ⟨dp, hdp⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep F₀
  obtain ⟨m, h, hspan, hG⟩ := dp.2
  refine ⟨m, h, hspan, fun l => ?_⟩
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C S (Localization.Away (h l))) :=
    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C S (Localization.Away (h l)) (h l)
  have hG' : ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away (h l)) π n,
      Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
        (dp.1.pullback (relCurveMap C S (Localization.Away (h l)))
          (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
            (relCurveMap C S (Localization.Away (h l))) dp.1)) := hG l
  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG'
  refine ⟨G, ?_⟩
  rw [← hdp]
  exact DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr hGdiv

variable (n) in
/-- **Restricted representatives of one Zar class agree after common base change**:
if `F₁` over `S₁` and `F₂` over `S₂` both restrict the class `F₀` over `S`, their
`mapAlg`s to a common `k`/`S`-tower ring `B` agree — `toZar` is injective and
intertwines the total maps, and the Zar-level base change composes over towers. -/
theorem DivFam.mapAlg_eq_mapAlg_of_toZar_restrict
    {S₁ : Type u} [CommRing S₁] [Algebra k S₁] [Algebra S S₁] [IsScalarTower k S S₁]
    {S₂ : Type u} [CommRing S₂] [Algebra k S₂] [Algebra S S₂] [IsScalarTower k S S₂]
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra S B] [IsScalarTower k S B]
    [Algebra S₁ B] [IsScalarTower k S₁ B] [IsScalarTower S S₁ B]
    [Algebra S₂ B] [IsScalarTower k S₂ B] [IsScalarTower S S₂ B]
    (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π n) (F₁ : DivFam C S₁ π n) (F₂ : DivFam C S₂ π n)
    (hZ₁ : F₁.toZar = DivFamZar.mapAlg S₁ n F₀)
    (hZ₂ : F₂.toZar = DivFamZar.mapAlg S₂ n F₀) :
    DivFam.mapAlg B n F₁ = DivFam.mapAlg B n F₂ := by
  refine DivFam.toZar_injective ?_
  rw [DivFam.toZar_mapAlg, DivFam.toZar_mapAlg, hZ₁, hZ₂,
    DivFamZar.mapAlg_comp S₁ n B F₀, DivFamZar.mapAlg_comp S₂ n B F₀]

10	/-!
11	# Locally certified divisor families: the `DivFamZar` carrier (DD-2 stage S5b)
12	
13	The Addendum-2 repair of the divisor-functor carrier (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`,
14	Addendum 2): the globally-certified `DivFam` is not a Zariski sheaf — the diagonal
15	divisor over `Γ(C \ pt)` is certifiable on a basic-open cover of the base but carries
16	no global certificate — so the faithful functor value is the **locally certified**
17	quotient `DivFamZar`. The generic germ-regularity engines live in
18	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarKit`.
19	
20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyCertified` — the Addendum-2 frozen pin: a span-⊤ family
21	  `g : Fin m → R` with certified divisor families over `Localization.Away (g i)`
22	  divisor-equal to the pulled system; `hreg` is discharged by the Kit's open-immersion
23	  lemma, with the S4 instance provided by `haveI`.
24	* `IsLocallyCertified.of_divEq` — the pin respects divisor equality.
25	* `CertifiedDivisorFamily.isLocallyCertified` — a global certificate is a local one
26	  (trivial cover `g = ![1]`; the certified part is `mapAlg` to `Localization.Away 1`,
27	  whose equations ARE the pulled system on the nose).
28	* `IsLocallyCertified.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors` — **the mapAlg-hreg
29	  engine**: a locally certified system has regular pulled equations along the
30	  comparison of an ARBITRARY test tower `R → R'` — regularity is germ-local, each germ
31	  sits over a chart `Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))` of `R'`, where the
32	  local certificate's regularity transports through its `DivEq` and the landed
33	  certificate-based pullback regularity.
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar` — the quotient of locally certified systems by
35	  `DivEq`, with `mk`, `mk_eq_mk_iff`, `picClass`, and `DivFam.toZar`.
36	
37	Total `DivFamZar.mapAlg` and the Zariski keystones are
38	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg` / `…ZarGlue`.
39	-/
40

64	/-- **The Addendum-2 frozen pin** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): a
65	local-equation system on the relative curve is *locally certified* in degree `n` if
66	some span-⊤ family `g : Fin m → R` carries certified divisor families over the
67	localizations `Localization.Away (g i)` that are divisor-equal to the pulled system.
68	The pullback's regularity hypothesis is discharged once and for all by the Kit's
69	open-immersion lemma — the comparison of an away localization is an open immersion
70	(the S4 instance, provided by `haveI`). -/
71	def IsLocallyCertified (n : ℕ) (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) : Prop :=
72	  ∃ (m : ℕ) (g : Fin m → R), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤ ∧
73	    ∀ i : Fin m,
74	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=

90	  refine ⟨m, g, hg, fun i => ?_⟩
91	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
92	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
93	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i
94	  exact ⟨G, hGdiv.trans
95	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
96	      h _ _)⟩

98	/-- **A global certificate is a local one** (the trivial cover `g = ![1]`): the
99	certified part over `Localization.Away (1 : R)` is `mapAlg` of the family, whose
100	equations are the pulled system on the nose (`pulledEquations` IS the pullback along
101	the comparison; the regularity proofs are proof-irrelevant). -/
102	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.isLocallyCertified {n : ℕ}
103	    (F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) : IsLocallyCertified C R π n F.eqns := by
104	  refine ⟨1, fun _ => (1 : R), ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
105	  · have hrange : Set.range (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : R)) = {1} := Set.range_const
106	    rw [hrange, Ideal.span_singleton_one]
107	  · haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (1 : R))) :=
108	      isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (1 : R)) 1
109	    exact ⟨F.mapAlg (Localization.Away (1 : R)) n,
110	      Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl _⟩

112	/-! ## The mapAlg-hreg engine -/

114	section MapAlgHreg
115	
116	variable {n : ℕ} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
117	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
118	
119	/-- **The mapAlg-hreg engine** (S5b): a locally certified system has regular pulled
120	equations along the comparison of an ARBITRARY test tower `R → R'`. Regularity is
121	germ-local on the curve: the charts `Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))` cover
122	`relCurve C R'` by open immersions; over each, the composite comparison factors
123	through the certified chart `Localization.Away (g i)`, where the certificate's
124	pullback regularity (`DivisorAdaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`)
125	transports through the recorded `DivEq`. -/
126	theorem IsLocallyCertified.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
127	    (hloc : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d)
128	    (y z : relCurve C R') (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) :
129	    ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y)
130	        z hz).hom (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R R') d y)
131	      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z) := by
132	  classical
133	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hloc
134	  -- the away charts of `R'` at the pushed cover, and their immersions
135	  haveI himm : ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin m),
136	      IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R'
137	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) := fun i =>
138	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R'
139	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
140	  -- the pushed family spans the unit ideal of `R'`
141	  have hspan' : Ideal.span (Set.range
142	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) = ⊤ := by
143	    have hrange : Set.range (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
144	        = algebraMap R R' '' Set.range g := by
145	      ext x
146	      constructor
147	      · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
148	        exact ⟨g i.down, ⟨i.down, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
149	      · rintro ⟨-, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
150	        exact ⟨⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
151	    rw [hrange, ← Ideal.map_span, hg, Ideal.map_top]
152	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_immersion_cover
153	    (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => relCurveMap C R'
154	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))))
155	    (fun y' => exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R'
156	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
157	      (fun i => Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) hspan' y')
158	    (relCurveMap C R R') d (fun i ζ => ?_) y z hz
159	  -- over the chart at `g i`: factor the composite through the certified localization
160	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i.down
161	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))) :=
162	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i.down)) (g i.down)
163	  -- the away map `Localization.Away (g i) → Localization.Away (φ (g i))` as an
164	  -- algebra tower
165	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away (g i.down))
166	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
167	    (IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers (g i.down))
168	      (T := Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
169	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R')
170	      (by
171	        rintro x ⟨e, rfl⟩
172	        use e
173	        simp)).toAlgebra
174	  haveI : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
175	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
176	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
177	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.map_comp,
178	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq])
179	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (g i.down))
180	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
181	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
182	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R (Localization.Away (g i.down)),
183	        ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
184	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
185	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))),
186	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R
187	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))])
188	  -- the comparison triangle through the two factorizations of `C_{T i} → C_R`
189	  have hcomp₁ : relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
190	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
191	      ≫ relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
192	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
193	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := Localization.Away (g i.down))
194	      (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
195	  have hcomp₂ : relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
196	      ≫ relCurveMap C R R'
197	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
198	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := R')
199	      (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
200	  have step1 := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_congr hcomp₂ d ζ
201	  have step2 := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_comp hcomp₁ d
202	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
203	      (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))) d) ζ
204	  have hfinal := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_self_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_divEq
205	    (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
206	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) hGdiv ζ
207	    (G.adaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
208	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
209	      G.certified.projective_colength ζ ζ
210	      ((G.eqns.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
211	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))))).mem_opens ζ))
212	  exact ((step1.trans step2).symm ▸ hfinal)
213	
214	end MapAlgHreg

222	`divFamSetoid`): the underlying local-equation systems cut the same divisor; the local
223	certificates are per-representative data and do not enter the relation. -/
224	def divFamZarSetoid : Setoid {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations //
225	    IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} where
226	  r d₁ d₂ := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁.1 d₂.1
227	  iseqv :=
228	    ⟨fun d => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl d.1,
229	     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩

231	/-- **The locally certified divisor-functor value on the affine test `R`**
232	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): locally certified local-equation systems of
233	degree `n` up to divisor equality. This is the carrier on which the divisor functor is
234	a Zariski sheaf — the globally certified `DivFam` remains the building block. -/
235	def DivFamZar : Type u := Quotient (divFamZarSetoid C R π n)
236	
237	namespace DivFamZar
238	
239	variable {C R π n}
240	
241	/-- The class of a locally certified system. -/
242	def mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) :
243	    DivFamZar C R π n :=
244	  Quotient.mk (divFamZarSetoid C R π n) ⟨d, hd⟩
245	
246	lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {d₁ d₂ : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
247	    {h₁ : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d₁} {h₂ : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d₂} :
248	    mk d₁ h₁ = mk d₂ h₂ ↔ Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁ d₂ :=
249	  Quotient.eq (r := divFamZarSetoid C R π n)
250	
251	/-- **The Picard class of a locally certified divisor class** `𝒪(D)`: well defined on
252	the quotient by `picClass_eq_of_divEq`. -/
253	noncomputable def picClass (F : DivFamZar C R π n) : (relCurve C R).CechPic :=
254	  Quotient.lift
255	    (fun d : {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations // IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} =>
256	      d.1.picClass)
257	    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_eq_of_divEq h) F
258	
259	@[simp]
260	lemma picClass_mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations)
261	    (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) : picClass (mk d hd) = d.picClass :=
262	  rfl
263	
264	end DivFamZar

266	variable {C R π n}
267	
268	/-- **The comparison from the globally certified value**: a certified family is
269	locally certified (trivial cover), and divisor equality is the relation on both
270	sides. Over a field the two notions agree; over a general base `toZar` is the
271	sheafification-of-value comparison. -/
272	def DivFam.toZar : DivFam C R π n → DivFamZar C R π n :=
273	  Quotient.lift
274	    (fun F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n =>
275	      DivFamZar.mk F.eqns F.isLocallyCertified)
276	    (fun _ _ h => DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr h)
277	
278	@[simp]
279	lemma DivFam.toZar_mk (F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) :
280	    (DivFam.mk F).toZar = DivFamZar.mk F.eqns F.isLocallyCertified :=
281	  rfl
282	
283	/-- The Picard class factors through `toZar`. -/
284	@[simp]
285	lemma DivFamZar.picClass_toZar (F : DivFam C R π n) :
286	    F.toZar.picClass = F.picClass := by
287	  induction F using Quotient.inductionOn with
288	  | h F => rfl
289	
290	end AlgebraicGeometry
